# Voice Commands by Locale

Every voice phrase the skill understands, in all 17 supported locales, generated directly from the interaction models so it can never go stale (the hand-maintained [VOICE_COMMANDS.md](../VOICE_COMMANDS.md) went stale twice). Regenerate after any model change:

```bash
python3 scripts/generate_voice_reference.py            # rewrite this doc
python3 scripts/generate_voice_reference.py --check   # exit 1 if stale
```

Source of truth: `Jellyfin.Plugin.AlexaSkill/Alexa/InteractionModel/model_<locale>.json`. Phrases are listed exactly as the models carry them; slot placeholders are rendered as readable hints explained in each locale's legend.

Invocation names: the skill answers to **"mia collezione"** in Italian and **"jellyfin player"** everywhere else. Defaults come from `Config.LocaleInvocationNames` (it-IT) and `Config.InvocationName` (all other locales) in `Jellyfin.Plugin.AlexaSkill/Config.cs`; a custom name set in the plugin settings replaces the default in all locales.

### <a id="ar-sa"></a>Arabic (ar-SA)

Default invocation name: **"jellyfin player"**. A custom invocation name set in the plugin settings replaces this default in every locale.

Any phrase can be used one-shot by saying Alexa, then the invocation name `jellyfin player`, then the phrase.

### <a id="en-ca"></a>English - Canada (en-CA)

Default invocation name: **"jellyfin player"**. A custom invocation name set in the plugin settings replaces this default in every locale.

Any phrase can be used one-shot by prefixing the invocation name, for example `Alexa, ask jellyfin player to play the song <song title>`. Samples that start with `to ` are infinitive forms meant exactly for this one-shot use.

### <a id="en-gb"></a>English - UK (en-GB)

Default invocation name: **"jellyfin player"**. A custom invocation name set in the plugin settings replaces this default in every locale.

Any phrase can be used one-shot by prefixing the invocation name, for example `Alexa, ask jellyfin player to play the song <song title>`. Samples that start with `to ` are infinitive forms meant exactly for this one-shot use.

### <a id="en-in"></a>English - India (en-IN)

Default invocation name: **"jellyfin player"**. A custom invocation name set in the plugin settings replaces this default in every locale.

Any phrase can be used one-shot by prefixing the invocation name, for example `Alexa, ask jellyfin player to play the song <song title>`. Samples that start with `to ` are infinitive forms meant exactly for this one-shot use.

| `<audiobook title>` | `{book}` |
| `<category (artists, albums, movies)>` | `{browse_category}` |

| `<chapter number>` | `{chapter_number}` |
| `<decade (the 80s)>` | `{decade}` |
| `<number of minutes>` | `{duration_minutes}` |

### <a id="en-us"></a>English - US (en-US)

Default invocation name: **"jellyfin player"**. A custom invocation name set in the plugin settings replaces this default in every locale.

Any phrase can be used one-shot by prefixing the invocation name, for example `Alexa, ask jellyfin player to play the song <song title>`. Samples that start with `to ` are infinitive forms meant exactly for this one-shot use.

### <a id="fr-ca"></a>French - Canada (fr-CA)

Default invocation name: **"jellyfin player"**. A custom invocation name set in the plugin settings replaces this default in every locale.

Any phrase can be used one-shot by addressing `jellyfin player` directly. Samples that start with `De ` are infinitive forms meant exactly for this one-shot use.

### <a id="fr-fr"></a>French (fr-FR)

Default invocation name: **"jellyfin player"**. A custom invocation name set in the plugin settings replaces this default in every locale.

Any phrase can be used one-shot by addressing `jellyfin player` directly. Samples that start with `De ` are infinitive forms meant exactly for this one-shot use.

### <a id="de-de"></a>German (de-DE)

Default invocation name: **"jellyfin player"**. A custom invocation name set in the plugin settings replaces this default in every locale.

Any phrase can be used one-shot by addressing `jellyfin player` directly. Samples that start with `Zu ` are infinitive forms meant exactly for this one-shot use.

### <a id="hi-in"></a>Hindi (hi-IN)

Default invocation name: **"jellyfin player"**. A custom invocation name set in the plugin settings replaces this default in every locale.

Any phrase can be used one-shot by saying Alexa, then the invocation name `jellyfin player`, then the phrase.

### <a id="it-it"></a>Italian (it-IT)

Default invocation name: **"mia collezione"**. A custom invocation name set in the plugin settings replaces this default in every locale.

Any phrase can be used one-shot by prefixing the invocation name, for example `Alexa, chiedi a mia collezione di suonare il brano <titolo del brano>`. Samples that start with `Di ` are infinitive forms meant exactly for this one-shot use.

### <a id="ja-jp"></a>Japanese (ja-JP)

Default invocation name: **"jellyfin player"**. A custom invocation name set in the plugin settings replaces this default in every locale.

Any phrase can be used one-shot by saying Alexa, then the invocation name `jellyfin player`, then the phrase.

Default invocation name: **"jellyfin player"**. A custom invocation name set in the plugin settings replaces this default in every locale.

### <a id="es-mx"></a>Spanish - Mexico (es-MX)

Default invocation name: **"jellyfin player"**. A custom invocation name set in the plugin settings replaces this default in every locale.

Any phrase can be used one-shot by saying Alexa, then the invocation name `jellyfin player`, then the phrase.

Default invocation name: **"jellyfin player"**. A custom invocation name set in the plugin settings replaces this default in every locale.

## Appendix: labels and intent names (for maintainers)

The body above is user-facing and never names intents or handlers. This table maps every group heading and command label back to the intent name in the interaction models.

| Group | Command label | Intent name |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Play music | Play a song | `PlaySongIntent` |
| Play music | Play an artist | `PlayArtistSongsIntent` |
| Play music | Play by genre | `PlayByGenreIntent` |
| Play music | Play by decade | `PlayByDecadeIntent` |
| Play music | Play music for a mood | `PlayMoodMusicIntent` |
| Play music | Play a playlist | `PlayPlaylistIntent` |
| Play music | Shuffle a playlist | `ShufflePlayIntent` |
| Play music | Play something random | `PlayRandomIntent` |
| Play music | Play recently added media | `PlayLastAddedIntent` |
| Play albums | Play an album | `PlayAlbumIntent` |
| Play videos | Play a video or movie | `PlayVideoIntent` |
| Episodes and series | Play an episode | `PlayEpisodeIntent` |
| Episodes and series | Play the next episode | `PlayNextEpisodeIntent` |
| Podcasts | Play a podcast | `PlayPodcastIntent` |
| Audiobooks | Play an audiobook | `PlayBookIntent` |
| Radio and live TV | Start radio mode | `PlayRadioIntent` |
| Radio and live TV | Turn radio mode on | `TurnRadioOnIntent` |
| Radio and live TV | Turn radio mode off | `TurnRadioOffIntent` |
| Radio and live TV | Play a live TV channel | `PlayChannelIntent` |
| Search | Search the library | `SearchMediaIntent` |
| Search | Find a song (multi-turn conversation) | `FindSongIntent` |
| Search | Find a song by an artist | `FindSongByArtistIntent` |
| Queue and repeat | Add to the queue | `AddToQueueIntent` |
| Queue and repeat | Play next | `PlayNextIntent` |
| Queue and repeat | Clear the queue | `ClearQueueIntent` |
| Queue and repeat | List the queue | `ListQueueIntent` |
| Queue and repeat | Loop the current song | `LoopSongOnIntent` |
| Queue and repeat | Repeat the current track | `RepeatSingleOnIntent` |
| Queue and repeat | Repeat all | `LoopAllOnIntent` |
| Queue and repeat | Turn repeat off | `LoopAllOffIntent` |
| Favorites | Play favorites | `PlayFavoritesIntent` |
| Favorites | Mark as favorite | `MarkFavoriteIntent` |
| Favorites | Remove from favorites | `UnmarkFavoriteIntent` |
| Info and queries | Ask about what is playing | `MediaInfoIntent` |
| Info and queries | Ask what the library has by an artist | `QueryArtistLibraryIntent` |
| Browse and discover | Browse the library | `BrowseLibraryIntent` |
| Browse and discover | Get a recommendation | `RecommendIntent` |
| Browse and discover | Ask what is new | `QueryRecentlyAddedIntent` |
| Browse and discover | Show more | `ShowMoreIntent` |
| Resume and continue | Continue watching or listening | `ContinueWatchingIntent` |
| Resume and continue | List what is in progress | `InProgressMediaListIntent` |
| Playback control | Go to a chapter | `GoToChapterIntent` |
| Playback control | Skip forward or back | `SkipForwardBackIntent` |
| Playback control | Jump to a position | `JumpToPositionIntent` |
| Playback control | Follow me (move playback here) | `FollowMeIntent` |
| Playback control | Pause | `AMAZON.PauseIntent` |
| Playback control | Resume | `AMAZON.ResumeIntent` |
| Playback control | Stop | `AMAZON.StopIntent` |
| Playback control | Next track | `AMAZON.NextIntent` |
| Playback control | Previous track | `AMAZON.PreviousIntent` |
| Playback control | Shuffle on | `AMAZON.ShuffleOnIntent` |
| Playback control | Shuffle off | `AMAZON.ShuffleOffIntent` |
| Playback control | Start over | `AMAZON.StartOverIntent` |
| Playback control | Repeat all on | `AMAZON.LoopOnIntent` |
| Playback control | Repeat all off | `AMAZON.LoopOffIntent` |
| Timers and reminders | Set a sleep timer | `SleepTimerIntent` |
| Timers and reminders | Set a reminder | `SetReminderIntent` |
| Account and voice | Learn my voice | `LearnMyVoiceIntent` |
| Account and voice | Who am I | `WhoAmIIntent` |
| Session and conversation | Help | `AMAZON.HelpIntent` |
| Session and conversation | Cancel | `AMAZON.CancelIntent` |
| Session and conversation | Fallback | `AMAZON.FallbackIntent` |
| Session and conversation | Yes | `AMAZON.YesIntent` |
| Session and conversation | No | `AMAZON.NoIntent` |

Invocation-name defaults live in `Jellyfin.Plugin.AlexaSkill/Config.cs` (`Config.LocaleInvocationNames` for it-IT, `Config.InvocationName` otherwise); a per-user custom name overrides them everywhere via `Config.EffectiveInvocationName`.
